The Historical reading is one of the [[Four interpretations]] alongside the [[typological]], [[tropological]], and [[anagogical]] readings

In the [[Gaiad]] the historical meaning is still metaphorical in its nature, but it is significantly more concrete than the other interpretations. For exmaple the [[five Suns]] reflect a possible history rather than one that was necessarily the case.
